---
name: "nf-core/fasta_clean_faidx"
description: "Ensure input fasta assemblies are unzipped and indexed, optionally generating\
  \ a chromosome sizes file."
keywords:
- "index"
- "faidx"
- "dict"
- "gunzip"
- "fasta"
components:
- "gunzip"
- "seqkit/seq"
- "seqkit/replace"
- "samtools/faidx"
- "samtools/dict"
input:
- ch_reference:
    type: "file"
    description: "Input fasta reference assembly.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(fasta)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{(fasta,fa,fna)(.gz)}"
- val_replace_dots:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to replace dots in the fasta reference name with underscores.\n\
      \nSome tools can't handle dots in the fasta name, however,\nsometimes the ID\
      \ must remain unchanged.\n"
- val_get_chromsizes:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to generate a chromosome sizes file from the fasta reference.\n"
- val_get_dict:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to generate a SAMTOOLS dictionary file from the fasta reference.\n"
output:
- reference:
    type: "file"
    description: "Input fasta reference assembly.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(fasta)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fna}"
- fai:
    type: "file"
    description: "SAMTOOLS FASTA index file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(fai)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.fai"
- sizes:
    type: "file"
    description: "Chromosome sizes file - a TSV with two columns (name and size) and\
      \ no header line.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(sizes) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{sizes,tsv}"
- dict:
    type: "file"
    description: "SAMTOOLS dictionary file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(dict)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.dict"
- sequence_description:
    type: "file"
    description: "JSON file containing number of sequences, total sequence length\
      \ and max_length.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(sequence_description) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.json"
authors:
- "@DLBPointon"
maintainers:
- "@DLBPointon"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/gunzip@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/seqkit/seq@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/seqkit/replace@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/samtools/faidx@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/samtools/dict@0.0.0-df69bf6"
